criteria.notes: One approved 16:9 poster with live offer copy, reproduced rather than reflowed.
No customer artwork was supplied; the composition is agent-authored to demonstrate the archetype.
Evergreen field with a brass accent and print-poster typography; no card, no header bar, no rail.
Headline and price dominate at hall distance; the fit floor keeps the headline above 84 design px.
Verified in the default palette and a re-skinned navy brand, both with a distinct surround.
Long-copy scenario fits the headline within its authored block instead of pushing the price.
The same poster at 1920x1080, 1280x720, 900x900, 1080x1920 and 1920x540 - scaled, never rearranged.
No raster artwork: the glow is a canvas gradient, so it scales exactly and costs nothing.
The only example that refuses to reflow; every other one adapts its layout to the surface.
